verses.text: Hallelu YAH! Sing to YHWH a new song—His praise in the assembly of the holy ones!

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! Sing to YHWH a new song—His praise in the assembly of the holy ones!

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion rejoice in their King!

segments.text: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion rejoice in their King!

verses.text: Let them praise His name with dancing; with tambourine and harp let them make music to Him!

verses.text: For YHWH delights in His people; He adorns the humble with salvation.

segments.text: For YHWH delights in His people; He adorns the humble with salvation.

verses.text: Let the holy ones exult in [His] glory; let them sing for joy upon their beds.

verses.text: Let the high praises of God [be] in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

verses.text: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments against the peoples,

verses.text: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with shackles of iron,
